title: Free GTA 6 is a scam: how the trap works
yt_title: Free GTA 6? It's a SCAM 🚨 Here's how the trap works
description: Have you seen a free GTA 6 offer? It's a scam. Malwarebytes found a 'free copy' site that asks for an account verification, then sends you to a fake Google sign-in page to steal your login (McAfee and GB News repeat the warning). There's no PC or mobile version of GTA 6 at all, and NordVPN even found GTA 6 scam kits sold on the dark web. Have you seen this scam yet? Comment where you saw it.

lines.text: Have you seen a free GTA 6 offer? It's a scam. Here's how it works.
lines.headline: SCAM ALERT

items.t: Free GTA 6 after a quick account check

lines.text: Step one: a fake site promises a free copy after an account check.
lines.headline: STEP 1

lines.text: Step two: that check sends you to a fake Google sign-in page.
lines.headline: STEP 2

scene.title: The fake login
scene.sub: It looks like Google. It isn't.

lines.text: Step three: you type your password, and the scam steals your login.
lines.headline: STEP 3

scene.title: Account stolen
scene.sub: Your Google login goes to the scammers

lines.text: And there's no PC or mobile version at all. NordVPN even found GTA 6 scam kits sold on the dark web.
lines.headline: THE TRUTH

items.t: Scam kits sold on the dark web

lines.text: Red flags: a free copy, an account check, a Google sign-in, or a PC download. McAfee says any free download is a scam.
lines.headline: RED FLAGS
